title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: When a parent disagrees
hook: A parent thinks your batting order is all wrong.
intro: They bring it up after practice.
They have watched a lot of games on TV.
statement: Listening is not the same as agreeing.
q1: Do you hear them out and explain your thinking —
q2: or thank them and keep the conversation short?
q3: What do they actually want for their child?
t1: Both can work. But these talks stay calm
cta: Coaches — how do you handle strategy critics?
ctaLines: Listen first. Explain once. Set a boundary.
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent thinks your batting order is all wrong.
They bring it up after practice. They have watched a lot of games on TV.
Listening is not the same as agreeing.
Explain your thinking or keep it short. There is no single right way.
How do you handle strategy critics? Share your habit in the comments.
